items.text: Round-2 answers incorporated: (d1) migration delivery pinned to a new 003_pii_watchlist_allowlist.sql alongside schema.sql DDL; (d2) per-file timeout pinned to 2s with a dedicated scan_skip finding shape emitted (type=scan_skip, severity=info, snippet='skipped: too_large'|'skipped: timeout') so oversized/slow files are visible without persistence; (d3) UI placement pinned to two new sections (PIIWatchlistManager.tsx, AllowlistRulesManager.tsx) reachable via a tab switcher on the existing SecurityTables section; (d4) context-aware filter scope pinned to the full set (go imports, build tags, go.mod/go.sum, lockfiles, URLs in comments, version strings).

Plan tightening in this finalize pass: added UNIQUE constraint on scan_allowlist_rules.path_pattern so ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING is well-formed for seed rules; added a Contract Decisions subsection formally defining the scan_skip finding shape and clarifying that scan_skip markers are NOT persisted to security_vulnerabilities (in-memory response only); reworded the Rollout Checklist so verification uses automated tests rather than manual sanity steps.

Known scope gap the executor must handle: the current acceptance_allow (scenarios/secrets-manager/api/**, scenarios/secrets-manager/ui/**) does not cover the migrations/schema.sql path this plan writes to. The plan now explicitly calls this out in 'Current Technical Context → Acceptance-Allow Expansion Required' and in the first Rollout Checklist item. The executor must widen acceptance_allow to include scenarios/secrets-manager/initialization/storage/postgres/** before running; without that change the 'no changes outside acceptance_allow' verification will fail.

Initiative alignment (gct-pre-commit-security): this item is the foundation — the downstream execute items (gct-security-review-tab, gct-commit-level-gating, gct-commit-level-agent) depend on the scan-files endpoint contract defined here. The finding shape (including scan_skip markers and watchlist_available) is the integration contract those items will consume, so any post-plan tweaks should preserve it.
Readiness is at 3/3 across all five dimensions. No remaining decisions, no unfilled placeholders. The plan can proceed to execution once acceptance_allow is widened.

plan_updates: Finalization: (1) pinned 2s per-file timeout explicitly in Scope and Phase 5 step 1; (2) added explicit oversized-file handling (Phase 5 step 2) and per-file timeout handling (Phase 5 step 3) with scan_skip finding emission; (3) added Finding Shape subsection under Contract Decisions defining normal vs scan_skip finding shapes and their persistence semantics; (4) added UNIQUE constraint on scan_allowlist_rules.path_pattern in Phase 1 DDL so the seed ON CONFLICT (path_pattern) DO NOTHING is valid; (5) added 'Acceptance-Allow Expansion Required' callout in Current Technical Context and corresponding first item in Rollout Checklist + a new Risks row; (6) replaced manual sanity steps in Rollout Checklist with automated test items.
